title: ForkLiftProjectSubmission
description: JSON schema for ForkLift catalog project submissions and mirror records.

tagline.description: Crisp one-line summary of what the project does.

description.description: Full markdown-formatted description of the project.

categorySlug.description: Slug of the primary category (from categories.json).

stage.description: Current development stage: finished, wip, or adoption.

licenseSpdx.description: SPDX license expression (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0) or null if unlicensed.

liveUrl.description: Live production demo URL, if available.

releaseUrl.description: Latest packaged release or download URL, if available.

stack.description: Tech stack components (e.g. React, Cloudflare Workers, SQLite).

platforms.description: Supported target platforms (e.g. web, cli, mobile, macos, windows, linux).

aiTools.description: AI coding assistants used (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, v0).

buildTime.description: Approximate vibe-coding build duration (e.g. '3 hours', '1 weekend').

aiInvolvement.description: Degree of AI code generation vs manual coding.

isTemplate.description: Whether this repo is designed specifically as a starter template.

replaces.description: Commercial/subscription tools this open project replaces (e.g. ['Notion', 'Trello']).

whatWorks.description: For WIP projects: what is already working.

whatsMissing.description: For WIP projects: what is still missing or broken.

lookingForHelp.description: Specific areas where the author invites collaboration or help.
